svg.title: XRD phase evolution of a bioactive silicate ceramic, 700 to 1100 °C (schematic)
svg.desc: Stacked X-ray diffraction patterns with reference stick patterns for wollastonite, whitlockite and hydroxyapatite/fluorapatite.
svg.text: Bioactive silicate ceramic · powder XRD · Cu Kα (λ = 1.5406 Å) · schematic illustration
Markers ▼ ■ ● flag the strongest reflection of each phase. HA and FAp overlap at Cu Kα (≈31.8°, 32.2°, 32.9°) and cannot be separated by XRD alone.
Schematic: patterns are simulated and angles approximate. Replace with measured scans and ICDD/COD peak lists before citing.
